text: Concrete shall be designed per EN 1992-1-1 with the Turkish National Annex and TBDY 2018 / TS 500 for seismic detailing, and shall be specified per EN 206 and TS EN 197-1. The exposure classes shall be: XS1 for above-ground elements exposed to airborne salt (all outdoor elements, given corrosivity C5 and chloride deposition of the site); XS3 for elements in the tidal and splash zone and within 2 m above the maximum sea level (intake and outfall structures, CW pumphouse pit walls); XS2 and XA2 for elements below the groundwater level (foundations, basements, pits, tank foundations); XC4 / XF1 are not decisive.
